description: This file is a PHP source code for the 'Login' controller within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, handling user login functionality, session management, and related account operations.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: Controller class for managing user login actions in OpenCart, including rendering login page, processing login requests, token management, and session handling.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the login page, initializes session tokens, and handles redirection if the user is already logged in with a valid token.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Processes login requests, authenticates the user, manages login attempts, and redirects upon success or failure.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Generates login tokens for user sessions, handles customer token-based login overrides, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the current session and customer token to ensure the user is correctly authenticated.
